calibration: Each synthetic replicate estimates shared image offset and accuracy scales from the full 2100-record synthetic metadata. Source filters are applied only to demographic reconstruction.
unlock: exclude_unknown must pass ADPE/CHPE/GEPE; ground_only must pass CHPE/GEPE. ADPE ground_only is coverage-limited and nonblocking.
boundary: No real count magnitude is read or modeled.
No recovery threshold, predictor, forcing scale, time window or interaction may change.
Ground-only means raw vantage exactly ground.
